scope: Read-only audit of native independent surface mast meshes in the complete V15 model; no new surveyed or photo-verified coordinates

sources.title: GSI seamlessphoto tile catalogue
sources.credit: 国土地理院 / Geospatial Information Authority of Japan
sources.use: Overlay current model mast positions on the existing z18 mosaic (232844..232849, 103223..103229), using scripts/relayout/georef.py and subtracting 512,768 pixels. This overlay is an analysis aid, not new pole-coordinate measurement.
sources.limitations: Individual imagery dates are not established. Inherited model registration, aerial parallax, roof occlusion and insufficient detail prevent one-to-one identification of every mast footing.

sources.title: Tokyo Station overhead 2020-10-25
sources.use: Visible support families and south-platform/throat relationships. It does not show all central/north mast bases; no coordinates extracted in this audit.

sources.title: JR East Tokyo station official map
sources.use: Track-number and level grouping; the map does not specify individual catenary mast locations.

model_diagram: Drawn only from native model coordinates and the repository's existing GSI-derived track/platform alignment. Existing repository source acknowledgements and licences continue to apply. Reference-photo pixels are not included.
